title: Attribute enforcement alert (v1, inbound)
description: What Attribute's alerting layer POSTs to the enforcement adapter. NOT what the adapter forwards to CloudFlow -- see cloudflow-trigger.v1.sample.json, which carries no secret material.

alert_id.description: Stable Attribute-side alert identifier. Basis of the idempotency key.

signal.description: Drives the containment tier. See adapter.policy.TIER_POLICY.

reason.description: Human-readable justification. Lands in the audit record.

provider.description: Only 'bedrock' is implemented today; others are rejected.

credential.description: The credential as observed on the wire. SECRET -- the adapter resolves it, derives the identity, and discards it. Never forwarded to CloudFlow, never logged.

key_hint.description: Truncated/redacted credential. Used when 'credential' is absent; usually will not decode, which routes the alert to the CloudTrail fallback.

workload_name.description: Attribute workload that spent the tokens (zprobe -workload-name).

requested_action.description: Advisory only, and can only LOWER the tier the adapter computes. Inbound payloads can never request destruction -- tier 3 is reachable only via human approval inside CloudFlow.
